tables.title: Median household income
tables.description: Source-published median household income for states and equivalents, Census original 90% margin of error, five-year pooled ACS reference period.

tables.title: Median owner-occupied home value
tables.description: Source-published median owner-occupied housing unit value in inflation-adjusted vintage dollars, with original 90% margin of error.

tables.title: Median gross rent
tables.description: Source-published median gross rent in inflation-adjusted vintage dollars with original 90% margin of error, not a single-year market rent index.

tables.title: Median age
tables.description: Source-published five-year pooled median age for states and equivalents, including original 90% margin of error.

tables.title: Total resident population (ACS estimate)
tables.description: Source-published ACS five-year survey estimate of total persons; not the Population Estimates Program official annual population total; original 90% margin of error retained.

tables.title: Household income inequality (Gini index)
tables.description: Source-published ACS five-year Gini index of income inequality among households, retaining the original estimate and 90% margin of error; not a causal measure.

tables.title: Housing occupancy status
tables.description: Source-published ACS five-year total housing unit universe for occupancy status, retaining original estimate and 90% margin of error without inferring vacancy rates.

tables.title: Occupied housing tenure
tables.description: Source-published ACS five-year occupied housing unit universe for owner and renter tenure, retaining original estimate and 90% margin of error without inferring ownership rates.

tables.title: Total housing units
tables.description: Source-published housing unit totals for states and equivalents, with original controlled or published Census margin of error.

tables.title: Population in occupied housing units by tenure
tables.description: Source-published total population living in occupied housing units, retaining the original publisher estimate and 90% margin of error.

tables.title: Average household size of occupied housing units
tables.description: Source-published average household size among occupied housing units, retaining Census original source values and 90% margin of error.

tables.title: Median year structure built
tables.description: Source-published median construction year of structures, retaining original Census estimate and 90% margin of error.

tables.title: Lower contract rent quartile
tables.description: Original Census five-year lower quartile of contract rent for cash-rent renter housing units, including publisher 90% margin of error. This is not a current-year asking rent.

tables.title: Median contract rent
tables.description: Original Census five-year median contract rent among renter-occupied units paying cash rent, including publisher 90% margin of error and release-vintage dollar units.

tables.title: Upper contract rent quartile
tables.description: Original Census five-year upper contract rent quartile for renter-occupied units paying cash rent; preserves the publisher estimate and reported 90% margin of error.

tables.title: Median gross rent share of household income
tables.description: Original five-year Census estimate of median gross rent as a percentage of household income for renter-occupied units paying cash rent; not an ARFI-calculated affordability ratio.
